name: FundingPips Clipping
brief: FundingPips is a prop trading firm (traders get simulated funded accounts after passing an evaluation). Pick the strongest, high-impact verbal moments or emotional highlights: trading psychology, discipline, handling risk, passing evaluation phases, scaling accounts, real trader stories and payouts. Hooks must be hyper-aggressive (stop the scroll in 1-3 seconds) but honest. FORBIDDEN: presenting funding as free money or get-rich-quick, implying guaranteed profits/payouts/passing, or cheating evaluation rules. Keep it professional, focused on skill, execution and risk management.
